categories.name: Binary exploitation
categories.gloss: Feeding a program input it was never built to survive, until it hands you control.

categories.name: Reverse engineering
categories.gloss: Taking a compiled binary apart with no source code, until you understand what it does and why.

categories.name: Web exploitation
categories.gloss: Finding the one request a web app trusts that it shouldn't. The category most people start in.

categories.name: Cryptography
categories.gloss: Breaking the maths, or more often, breaking the way someone used the maths.

categories.name: Forensics
categories.gloss: Reconstructing what happened from a disk image, a packet capture, or a memory dump.

categories.name: OSINT
categories.gloss: Finding what is technically public and practically hidden. No tooling required to begin.
